subject: Staged VPC version sunset & rollback theater
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Harriet Klein <harriet@mercantilehealth.com>
Cc: SRE Team <ops@mercantilehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Staged VPC version sunset & rollback theater

Team,

Following our ops review yesterday I sketched a short, staged plan for sunsetting the older 1.8.x runtime on Mercantile's private VPC and the rollback/rollforward theatre we'll rehearse. The goal is to retire 1.8 without customer-visible regressions while keeping an explicit, tested escape path (manual + automated).

High-level proposal (summary):
- Window: 2028-07-20 02:00–06:00 UTC (narrow, US-East friendly).
- Strategy: 2-phase canary -> fast rollforward -> monitored widen.
- Pin policy: keep one 1.8 node pool pinned for 72 hours post-rollout for quick rehydrate.
- Rollback trigger: sustained 5%+ LB error delta for 10m OR quality regression on the sampled prompt set.

I'm attaching a runbook and a staggered-version matrix. Please review the specific escape actions below and call out any missing dependencies.

Action items for this thread:
1) Rishi: validate the KV cache invalidation steps and the expected memory pressure from the new kernels.
2) Kimberly: confirm audit logging retention toggles (we need request-level SDA logging for the 48h post-rollout window).
3) Aditya: confirm control-plane flag to auto-pin nodepool on rollback and the expected time to reprovision (target < 12m).
4) Harriet / Mercantile ops: confirm the blackout allowance and whether you want us to move to a midnight local window instead.

Attachments: PatchRunbook_v2.pdf (runbook), staged-sunset-matrix.csv (node mapping), canary-checklist.md

Thanks — I want us ready to rehearse on Wed (2028-07-18).

--
Marissa Cole
Principal PM, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Harriet Klein <harriet@mercantilehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Jul 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Staged VPC version sunset & rollback theater

Thanks Marissa — quick follow-ups below.

KV / memory notes:
- New kernel has slightly higher transient heap on cold starts (~80MB/node) when priming large KV segments. We'll need to bump the drain timeout from 45s -> 75s for safe migration.
- Suggested canary: 3 pods, synthetic workload at 10rps, 30m soak. If OK, we can auto-scale to 6 pods for the fast widen.

Rollback mechanics (detailed):
- Automatic rollback will flip routing to pinned 1.8 nodepool via DR policy (route weight to pinned=100%).
- Fallback step includes an optional KV prune: run kv-prune --since "2028-07-20T00:00Z" --dry-run then commit only if memory reclaim observed.
- Time-to-recover: 8–12m typical; if control-plane fails, manual weight switch via API is ~3m.

I'll update PatchRunbook_v2.pdf with the prune commands and a quick memory-check script.

Rishi
SRE Lead
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Harriet Klein <harriet@mercantilehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Jul 2028 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Staged VPC version sunset & rollback theater

Marissa — noted. A couple items from security/compliance side:

- Audit logging: we'll enable request-level SDA for the 48h post-cutover as you requested but need to confirm retention: Mercantile's SOC team requires 90-day visible window; I'll need a signed approval.
- Data residency: verify that pinned nodepool does not shift workload to a different AZ that would violate your SLA. I'll add an AZ affinity gating in the matrix.

Also adding a small preflight to canary-checklist.md: a tamper-proof hash of the model artifacts (sha256) to avoid mismatched images during rollout.

If Mercantile needs a later window, earliest alternate is 2028-07-21 03:00–07:00 UTC.

Kimberly
Security & Compliance
From: Harriet Klein <harriet@mercantilehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Jul 2028 08:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Staged VPC version sunset & rollback theater

Thanks all — good detail. A couple replies from Mercantile ops: 

- Window: 2028-07-21 03:00–07:00 UTC works better for our midnight tech staff, please update docs accordingly.
- SOC approval: I'll route the 90-day retention ask through our compliance owner today and send approval if green. Expect reply by EOD Monday (2028-07-09).
- Can you confirm whether auto-pin will maintain the old kernel image (1.8) or rehydrate from snapshot? We prefer image-preserve so we don't introduce any drift while failing back.

If you can provide a short rehearsal recording of the manual rollback steps we can do an internal dry-run.

—Harriet
Director, Infrastructure
Mercantile Health Operations
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Harriet Klein <harriet@mercantilehealth.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 7 Jul 2028 16:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Staged VPC version sunset & rollback theater

Great — updated plan below and next steps.

Plan updates (finalized):
- Cutover window moved to 2028-07-21 03:00–07:00 UTC per Mercantile.
- Auto-pin will preserve the running 1.8 image in a cold reserved pool (no snapshot rehydrate) — Aditya confirmed the control-plane flag is image-preserve.
- Preflight rehearsal: we'll record a 12-minute screen + voice dry-run of the manual rollback (weight switch + optional kv-prune) and upload to the Confluence runbook by 2028-07-12.
- Kimberly: proceed with SDA enablement and note retention approval when Harriet confirms.
- Rishi: please include the memory-check script and the adjusted drain timeout in the final runbook.

I'll schedule a 30-min dress rehearsal for Wed 2028-07-18 16:00 UTC. Invite to follow.

Attachments: updated PatchRunbook_v2.pdf (changes highlighted)

Thanks everyone — feel free to flag anything that would block approval.

--
Marissa Cole
Principal PM, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
